The builder applies the following default configuration:

- Port: `9091` (see `MilvusBuilder.MilvusManagementPort`)
- Port: `19530` (see `MilvusBuilder.MilvusGrpcPort`)
- Environment variable: `DEPLOY_MODE=STANDALONE`
- Environment variable: `COMMON_STORAGETYPE=local`
- Environment variable: `ETCD_USE_EMBED=true`
- Environment variable: `ETCD_CONFIG_PATH=/milvus/configs/embedEtcd.yaml`
- Environment variable: `ETCD_DATA_DIR=/var/lib/milvus/etcd`
- Command: `milvus run standalone`
- File: `/milvus/configs/embedEtcd.yaml`

    ```
    advertise-client-urls: http://0.0.0.0:2379
    listen-client-urls: http://0.0.0.0:2379
    ```

- Create parameter: `Healthcheck.Test=["CMD-SHELL","curl -f http://localhost:9091/healthz"]`
- Create parameter: `Healthcheck.Interval="00:00:30"`
- Create parameter: `Healthcheck.Timeout="00:00:20"`
- Create parameter: `Healthcheck.StartPeriod="00:01:30"`
- Create parameter: `Healthcheck.Retries=3`
- Wait strategy: Waits until the container is healthy.
